map.土壤有机质含量估算器 使用指南: Soil Organic Matter Estimator User Guide
map.土壤有机质估算器，基于灼烧失重法估算有机质与有机碳含量，辅助地力评价与培肥决策。: Soil Organic Matter Estimator: estimates organic matter and organic carbon content with the loss on ignition method, supporting soil fertility assessment and fertilization decisions.
map.烧失率 = (烧前重 − 烧后重) ÷ 烧前重 × 100%；有机碳 = 烧失率: Loss fraction = (weight before − weight after) ÷ weight before × 100%; organic carbon = loss fraction × temperature correction factor (400 °C 0.50 / 550 °C 0.58 / other 0.65); organic matter = organic carbon × conversion factor
map.灼烧失重法：先求烧失率，再乘温度校正系数得有机碳。烧失量中部分为结构水等非有机质: Loss on ignition method: first compute the loss fraction, then multiply by the temperature correction factor to get organic carbon. Part of the loss is structural water and other non-organic material, so it is corrected for ignition temperature (the 550 °C standard uses 0.58). Organic matter is organic carbon times the conversion factor (from carbon fraction, commonly 1.724), and results are graded from extremely deficient to extremely rich to guide fertilization.
map.填写「灼烧前干土重(g)」。: Enter the "dry soil weight before ignition (g)".
map.有机质（重铬酸钾法）= 消耗氧化剂量折算 × 常数 / 土样干重。: Organic matter (potassium dichromate method) = the oxidant consumption converted × a constant / dry soil weight.
map.烧失法仅粗估，含无机误差。: The loss on ignition method is a rough estimate and includes inorganic error.
map.用于耕地质量等级与培肥评价。: Used for farmland quality grading and fertilization assessment.
map.：风干土 0.5000 g 经重铬酸钾外加热法滴定，折算有机碳 5.8%，乘以系: : Air-dried soil 0.5000 g titrated by the potassium dichromate external heating method gives organic carbon 5.8%, and multiplying by the factor 1.724 gives organic matter ≈ 10.0%. This is typical fertile black soil, so keep returning straw to maintain it.

map.有机质和有机碳怎么换算？: How Do You Convert Between Organic Matter and Organic Carbon?
map.经验系数 1.724（有机质≈有机碳×1.724，假设有机质含碳 58%）。这是: The conventional factor is 1.724 (organic matter ≈ organic carbon × 1.724, assuming organic matter is 58% carbon). It is a long-standing conversion, but actual values vary with the soil.
map.怎么提升有机质？: How Do I Raise Organic Matter?
map.秸秆还田、增施有机肥/农家肥、种植绿肥、减少深耕扰动。是慢过程，数年才显效，需持: Returning straw to the field, adding more organic or farmyard manure, planting green manure crops, and reducing deep tillage. It is a slow process that only shows results after years and must be sustained.
